name: portal
label: Portal
description: Aperture Science. Institutional orange and blue on near-black, condensed signage type, and a voice that is procedural and faintly ominous.

copy.site.title: Aperture Screening Initiative
copy.site.tagline: Thirty-one volunteers. Two proposals each. One film survives the evaluation.
copy.quota.barred: You are cleared to evaluate this cycle, but not to propose.
copy.quota.at_limit: You have entered all {count} permitted this cycle.
copy.quota.heading: Your proposals
copy.home.lead: Thirty-one volunteers propose up to two candidate films each. A ranked, instant-runoff evaluation selects the one that will be screened. Participation is, technically, voluntary.
copy.home.notice.body: The testing track is being rebuilt for this cycle. Intake opens in early October, and the link will be delivered through the usual channel.
copy.home.steps.heading: Test protocol
copy.home.step1.title: Propose
copy.home.step1.body: Early October. Authenticate, then enter up to two candidate films. A trailer link measurably improves peer evaluation, and costs you nothing.
copy.home.step2.title: Evaluate
copy.home.step2.body: Rank your first three preferences, in order. The count is instant-runoff: a second preference is not discarded, it is held in reserve and applied the moment your first is eliminated.
copy.home.step3.title: Observe
copy.home.step3.body: Screening night. The selected film is projected, and the cycle is filed alongside every cycle that preceded it. Thank you for your participation.
copy.home.archive.heading: Previous cycles
copy.home.archive.empty: No cycles have been filed at this location yet. Earlier ones are transferred in as they are recovered, and then they remain.
copy.slate.count.heading: {count} on the testing track
copy.slate.hidden.body: This manifest includes withdrawn entries, flagged accordingly. No other subject can see them.
copy.slate.empty.heading: Nobody has volunteered yet
copy.slate.empty.body: Every cycle begins this way. The first entry sets the parameters everyone else proposes around — a responsibility the Initiative does not take lightly, and is placing on you regardless.
copy.slate.actions.signin_note: The manifest is public. Entering something into it is not.
copy.season.state.draft.label: Not authorised
copy.season.state.draft.summary: This cycle has not been authorised. The link will be delivered through the usual channel when it is.
copy.season.state.submitting.label: Intake open
copy.season.state.submitting.summary: Enter your candidates. Evaluation begins the moment intake closes.
copy.season.state.voting.label: Evaluation open
copy.season.state.voting.summary: Intake is closed. Rank your first three preferences — the second is what resolves a tie, and it is not wasted.
copy.season.state.locked.label: Sealed
copy.season.state.locked.summary: This cycle is complete and has been filed.
copy.outcome.tied.body: The final round of evaluation produced a level result, and no single candidate was selected. This outcome is within acceptable parameters.
copy.movie.trailer.title: Promotional material: {title}
copy.submit.heading: Submit a test chamber
copy.submit.lead: A title is the only required parameter. A trailer link and one line of justification measurably improve the probability that another subject ranks you first.
copy.submit.existing.heading: {count} entered by you this cycle
copy.submit.errors.heading: {count} to correct before this can be entered.
copy.submit.field.title.label: Title
copy.submit.field.title.hint: The name of the film. The one parameter the Initiative cannot infer.
copy.submit.field.year.label: Year
copy.submit.field.year.hint: Optional, four digits. It disambiguates remakes, of which the record shows many.
copy.submit.field.trailer.label: Promotional link
copy.submit.field.trailer.hint: Optional. A YouTube link plays inside the chamber; anything else is recorded as a link.
copy.submit.field.description.label: Justification
copy.submit.field.description.hint: Optional, and the part other subjects actually read. One sentence is sufficient.
copy.submit.blocked.locked.heading: That cycle is sealed
copy.submit.blocked.locked.body: {season} has been filed, and a filed cycle does not change. Its manifest is final.
copy.submit.blocked.voting.heading: Intake is closed
copy.submit.blocked.voting.body: Proposals are complete for this cycle — everything that qualified is on the manifest. Evaluation decides the remainder.
copy.submit.blocked.draft.heading: This cycle has not been authorised yet
copy.submit.blocked.draft.body_dated: The testing track opens on {date}. The link will be delivered through the usual channel.
copy.submit.blocked.draft.body_undated: Scheduling for this cycle is pending. The link will be delivered once it is not.
copy.submit.blocked.barred.heading: You are cleared to evaluate
copy.submit.blocked.barred.body: {quota} That is a setting on your file rather than an allowance you exhausted, so raise it through the usual channel if it appears to be in error.
copy.submit.blocked.at_limit.heading: That is both of your proposals
copy.submit.blocked.at_limit.body_dated: {quota} They are listed below. Evaluation begins on {date}.
copy.submit.blocked.at_limit.body_undated: {quota} They are listed below. Evaluation begins when intake closes.
copy.submit.blocked.outsider.heading: Testing is restricted to this cycle's volunteers
copy.submit.blocked.outsider.body: The manifest is public to read and not to write. If you are on this cycle's roster, authenticate with the account on file. If you are not, enquire through the usual channel.
copy.submit.blocked.unknown.heading: Not at this time
copy.submit.blocked.unknown.body: The chamber is not accepting your entry at the moment. The manifest remains available to read, and the usual channel is the fastest route to an explanation.
copy.error.404.heading: This chamber does not exist
copy.error.404.body: The link may be out of date, or a cycle that was never authorised. Nothing is malfunctioning. There is simply nothing at this address.
copy.error.500.heading: The facility has encountered a fault
copy.error.500.body: The server encountered an error and abandoned this page. The fault has been logged. Attempt it again shortly, and report it through the usual channel if it persists.
copy.error.405.heading: That is not a permitted operation
copy.error.405.body: The page exists, but not for the kind of request that reached it. This usually indicates a stale form, or a response that was resubmitted.
